name: Email to RSS
description: Fetches email messages from a configured IMAP mailbox folder and publishes them as an RSS 2.0 feed served at a token-gated URL. Syncs on cron or on demand.
project_description: Email to RSS turns messages in an IMAP mailbox folder into a private RSS 2.0 feed, so newsletters and other email-only content can be read in any feed reader instead of an inbox. You configure an IMAP account and one or more folders (one feed per folder), Drupal fetches the messages during cron or on demand via a Sync now button, and it exposes each folder's messages as a feed at a URL containing a secret per-feed token. Messages are mirrored into a local database table, deduplicated by RFC 2822 Message-ID, and pruned to a configurable per-feed limit. HTML email bodies are preserved and emitted in the feed's content:encoded element, and each item also has a browser-viewable HTML detail page. The IMAP connection (host, port, encryption, username, folder) lives in configuration; the mailbox password is read from the EMAIL_TO_RSS_IMAP_PASSWORD environment variable and is never stored in Drupal config. It depends only on the webklex/php-imap Composer library and requires Drupal 10/11 and PHP 8.2+. It is the reverse of core Aggregator: Aggregator consumes RSS, Email to RSS produces RSS from email.
